info.description: Run CSV in USD, GBP, INR order. TLS verification disabled under standing authorization. Empty inventory is WARN. Logs exact-key rank differences; differences require user tie review and are not automatic failures. Authentication: populate search_authorization locally. No provider tracks.

exec: console.warn('WARN: no inventory; currency ranking cannot be evaluated');
pm.test.skip('Currency ranking comparison: WARN - no inventory', () => {});
const ranks = rows.map((r, i) => ({ key: r.key, rank: i + 1 }));
const changes = ranks.flatMap(r => { const b = baseline.find(x => x.key === r.key); return b && b.rank !== r.rank ? [{ key: r.key, usd_rank: b.rank, actual_rank: r.rank }] : []; });
console.log('Observed rank differences (review ties before verdict)', changes);
